features: Analog Turbo HD — 1 HD analog output over coax; NOT an IP camera
Smart Hybrid Light: IR up to 25 m + white light up to 20 m
Active flashing light alarm (red & blue strobe) + audio alarm
Two-way audio: built-in mic + 2W speaker (audio over coax)
Echo cancellation, AI noise reduction, AGC
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE10DF0T-LPXTS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP two-way-audio fixed mini bullet with Smart Hybrid Light (IR to 25 m, white to 20 m), a red/blue strobe + audio alarm and two-way audio over coax (not IP). Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (DS-2CE10DF0T-LPXTS_Datasheet_20250603.pdf).
